✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

AImori is an open-source browser extension designed to protect sensitive data when interacting with AI websites. It operates locally within the browser, scanning prompts for personal information like bank details, credit card numbers, and PII before they are sent to AI services, offering options to redact or rephrase the content.
